Terms

Applying, requesting a walkthrough or signing in for the first time (which creates the email account) is not approval, a booking or a paid contract. Capture and hosting terms are agreed after assessment. This is not legal advice.

You must have permission to capture and share a space, and you must hold the rights to anything you upload. Do not upload other people’s private interiors without that permission, and keep street addresses, access codes and identity documents out of Veylet records — the desk rejects an address-shaped location for that reason. Concept imagery on this site is original and AI-generated. It is not a captured property or a client case study.

Veylet does not promise jobs, leads or earnings to operators. When we take payment it will be through Square, after assessment, for an agreed scope. This public site does not take cards. Square Sandbox exists in the product for internal tests only; production charging is off. Until checkout is proven, payment is invoiced. You may ask us to close an account at yoda@yodalai.xyz.
